newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TOP 15 BELGIAN COMPANIES IN PLANNED FT INDEX.
newsitem.headline: TOP 15 BELGIAN COMPANIES IN PLANNED FT INDEX.

text.p: Brussels top 15 companies in terms of market capitalisation will be included in the new pan-European Eurotop 300 index due to be launched in July by the Financial Times and Amsterdam Exchanges, the Dutch bourse group said on Friday.
As at March 31, 1997, the Belgian members of the Eurotop 300 were (in order given):
BBL , Fortis AG , Generale Bank , SGB , GBL , Kredietbank , Royale Belge , Solvay , UCB , Electrafina , PetroFina , Delhaize , Electrabel , Powerfin and Tractebel .
The composition by the launch date may have changed, given plans by Powerfin and Tractebel to merge.
The Financial Times said in its Friday edition existing indices, such as the FT S&P European and Morgan Stanley Capital International (MSCI), were not useful for derivatives.
The Amsterdam Exchanges plans to launch a series of options based on the new index.
